Local cable TV channels | parent = | website = {{URL|sitinetworks.com}} }} '''Siti Networks Ltd''', formerly known as '''Wire and Wireless (India) Limited (WWIL)''' and '''Siti Cable Network''', is a [[multi system operator]] (MSO) promoted by the [[Essel Group]] (a 6.1% stake holder).{{Cite web|last=Kar|first=Ayushi|title=Unpaid dues: Operational creditors may drag Siti Networks to NCLT|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/unpaid-dues-operational-creditors-may-drag-siti-networks-to-nclt/article36971994.ece|access-date=2021-10-18|website=@businessline|date=12 October 2021 |language=en}} The company provides digital cable television services in India and is headquartered in [[Noida]], [[Uttar Pradesh]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.dnaindia.com/analysis/comment_finally-tipping-point-for-cable-tv_1598562 |title=Finally, tipping point for Cable Television – DNA Analysis |access-date=16 October 2012 |archive-date=15 September 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120915003833/http://www.dnaindia.com/analysis/comment_finally-tipping-point-for-cable-tv_1598562 |url-status=live }} ==History== {{Unreferenced section|date=March 2025}} WWIL was formed as a part of the de-merger of [[Zee Entertainment Enterprises|Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited]] – ZEEL, formerly known as Zee Telefilms Limited (ZTL) – the publicly listed flagship company of Zee Group. As per the Scheme of Arrangement approved by the High Court in Mumbai, all the cable TV distribution business within ZEEL and Siti Cable Networks Limited (Siti Cable) was transferred to WWIL as of 31 March 2006. Siti Cable was a 100% subsidiary of Zee Telefilms Limited. The cable operations of Siti Cable were launched in June 1994. SITI Cable was known as Wire and Wireless (India) Limited till 5 September 2012 wherein after it is renamed as SITI Cable Network Limited. In 2016, it was renamed as Siti Networks Limited.{{cite news |title=Siti Cable Network renamed as Siti Networks |url=https://indiantelevision.com/cable-tv/multi-system-operators/siti-cable-network-renamed-as-siti-networks-160816 |access-date=20 March 2025 |work=indiantelevision.com |date=16 August 2016 |language=en}} == Finance == In the FY 2023–24, the company reported a revenue from operations of ₹866 crore, while it had revenue from operations of ₹918 crore in FY 2022–23. It reported a loss of ₹204.5 crore in FY24, and it had a loss of ₹314.5 crore in FY23.{{cite news |title=Siti Networks' ad income drops 20.3 percent to Rs 115.8 crore |url=https://www.storyboard18.com/advertising/siti-networks-ad-expenditure-drops-19-4-to-rs-2-9-crore-in-fy24-49667.htm |publisher=Storyboard18 |date=December 8, 2024}} Siti Networks has been under [[insolvency]] proceedings since February 2023, after [[IndusInd Bank]] filed a petition over an alleged default of ₹148 crore.{{cite news |last1=Yadav |first1=Krishna |title=NCLAT asks Axis Bank, Siti Network’s creditors to hold ₹143 crore in separate interest-bearing account |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/nclat-asks-axis-bank-siti-network-s-creditors-to-hold-143-crore-in-separate-interest-bearing-account-11730268451901.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=30 October 2024}} == See also == [[Hathway]] [[DEN Networks|Den Networks]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.siticable.com/ Official website] {{DTH in India}} {{Essel Group}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Companies based in Noida]] [[Category:Cable television companies of India]] [[Category:Television networks in India]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Internet service providers of India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1994]] [[Category:1994 establishments in Uttar Pradesh]] [[Category:Mass media companies established in 1994]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Essel Group]]
extract: Siti Networks Ltd, formerly known as Wire and Wireless (India) Limited (WWIL) and Siti Cable Network, is a multi system operator (MSO) promoted by the Essel Group (a 6.1% stake holder). The company provides digital cable television services in India and is headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
